title: PSRB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Persian ASR Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) error rates, specifically using the Substitution Weighted WER (SW-WER) metric, across different speaker age groups including children, teens, adults, and seniors.
Analyzing ASR performance discrepancies (SW-WER metric) between male and female speakers across standard and accented speech conditions.
Evaluating ASR system performance (SW-WER metric) across 12 different regional Persian accents/dialects and comparing the error rates to those of Standard Persian.
